title: Retro-Mars trailer and game: I need your advice. Testers more than welcome.
author: Ostermiss
selftext:
Hello!

I'd love to get your thoughts and feedback on my game trailer, as well as the game itself!

This is just a small project I made for fun with Claude Code only.

You can play the game here: [https://retro-mars.vercel.app](https://retro-mars.vercel.app)

The game is available in 4 languages, although I'm not entirely sure how accurate the translations are, since they were AI-generated.

  
If you have any questions I'd be happy to answer them.

Thanks in advance for your feedback. Any suggestions are welcome!

comments.author: Eon_purrlab
comments.body: Its look good, how did u manage to do the assets? How long have u been working in this project? Im making myself an small demo for a big project im planning and would love to hear ur experience on this one!

replies.author: Ostermiss
replies.body: Hello, I spend a lot of time on [https://marsattack](https://marsattackidle.com)[s](https://marsattackidle.com)[idle.com](https://marsattackidle.com) it is just a demo but I put a lot of effort to generate sprites. I had a first version and modified them manually ! Then the assets are “code” assets, the code is reproducing them ! In fact it was a short project I spend two weeks, with maybe 2-3 hours per day! The most important is doing engine alone first with placeholders, and the assets in parallel it will be easier. Now that I have all this sprite Claude is really good to decline multiple other sprites from other theme (you can look at the link above)
